title: Prove H2 Fleet parity and delete superseded H2 runtime
description: Own the cross-repository V8 feature matrix and deletion proof. Add the H2-side pinned Burrito contract fixture under tests/fleetparity/ and a make test-fleet-parity target included in CI. Record both repository SHAs, run H2 make check/test/test-external/test-fleet-parity and Burrito make test-fleet-h2-contract, then delete superseded H2 daemon, PTY transport, session registry, and independent search/index machinery from internal/session/ and callers. A Burrito-only green build cannot close this gate.
